outcome.answer: The matching paper is “Sympathetic Framing: Evaluating AI Alignment across Sociodemographic Groups” by Haran Shani-Narkiss, Michael Fire, and Oren Tsur [1]. It evaluates how closely LLMs’ judgments of sympathy-evoking news headlines align with human judgments, including across demographic subgroups [1]. The authors report broad alignment among leading models across groups, alongside statistically significant differences between groups [1].
